iv_drip.notes: Mobile stand, independent injection/donation indicator and reagent-container socket. Tube endpoint follows the patient in gameplay; no permanently attached fake patient or bag.

cryo_cell.notes: 32x64 source. Hollow chamber and curved transparent door rotate around vertical centre, below 2m ceiling. Separate original cooling overlay; patient is an attachment.

dna_scanner.notes: Separate green control tower and hollow patient chamber. Occupied/unpowered/maintenance indicators, rotating glass door and Patient socket. Occupant mesh is supplied by gameplay.

dna_infuser.notes: Opaque segmented chamber with separate opening door and control console; source marks this machinery obsolete, preserved as an asset.

bci_implanter.notes: 32x64 atlas body occupies rows 33-63. Hood retracts within frame to respect single-floor height. Patient/implant sockets; machine operation stays in gameplay.

chemical_dispenser.notes: Original dispenser family shape; beaker/cup is a separate attachment. Chemistry version includes power/display and dispensing sprite frames; drink taps are geometry.

soda_dispenser.notes: Original dispenser family shape; beaker/cup is a separate attachment. Chemistry version includes power/display and dispensing sprite frames; drink taps are geometry.

alcohol_dispenser.notes: Original dispenser family shape; beaker/cup is a separate attachment. Chemistry version includes power/display and dispensing sprite frames; drink taps are geometry.

chem_master.notes: Separate reagent/container output sockets and source idle/loaded/printing screen frames; maintenance panel. CondiMaster shares the ChemMaster screen overlays in source.

condiment_master.notes: Separate reagent/container output sockets and source idle/loaded/printing screen frames; maintenance panel. CondiMaster shares the ChemMaster screen overlays in source.

reaction_chamber.notes: Uses actual runtime mixer0b/mixer1b chamber family, not unrelated mixer0 console. Hollow beaker compartment and hinged glass; beaker contents remain separate.

hplc_chromatograph.notes: Two beaker sockets, independent monitor/power states, actual HPLC idle/analysis graphs, maintenance hatch.

medical_kiosk.notes: Full-size medical kiosk; off/idle/active display and separate tall service hatch.

smart_fridge.notes: Shared refrigerator geometry; original content overlays are selectable clips for eight item families and three fill levels. Glass and shelves are independent. Dryer has separate geometry. Contents planes preserve source atlas pixels.

dehydrator.notes: Shared refrigerator geometry; original content overlays are selectable clips for eight item families and three fill levels. Glass and shelves are independent. Dryer has separate geometry. Contents planes preserve source atlas pixels.

biological_growing_vat.notes: Low open-top vat with independent tintable reagent surface, controller and product attachment. Growth output is supplied at runtime.

chemical_synthesizer.notes: Blue synthesizer vessel and frame; reagent output socket only. Underfloor plumbing deliberately omitted.

operating_table.notes: One-cell operating table with patient anchor. Table surface 1.8m long; linked computer status is a gameplay indicator, not a second table model.

morgue_section.notes: Hollow body container; tray and front move into adjacent tile on open. Body anchor follows tray. Reserve one clear front cell. Cremation/medical status indications remain source states in metadata.

crematorium.notes: Hollow body container; tray and front move into adjacent tile on open. Body anchor follows tray. Reserve one clear front cell. Cremation/medical status indications remain source states in metadata.

manual_chemical_separator.notes: Small tabletop separator and beaker socket. Original blue glass and wooden base regions; heat/reagent behaviour remains gameplay.

microscope.notes: Small tabletop instrument with specimen-slide attachment.
